qualifier: cyclooxygenase prostanoid and cytochrome P450 (EET, HETE) branches
name: Prostaglandin and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid synthesis
rationale: All members concern arachidonate release and its conversion to eicosanoids via COX (prostaglandins, thromboxanes, fever) and P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase (EETs, HETEs), whereas confusables centre on leukotrienes, lipoxygenase products and pro-resolving mediators.

name: CFTR-mediated epithelial chloride and fluid secretion
rationale: Members cover CFTR trafficking, cystic fibrosis and transepithelial water transport, distinguishing the theme from confusables built on SLC26/SLC4/SLC12 anion transporters.

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
name: MHC class I and II antigen presentation, including HIV evasion
rationale: Members span peptide loading, cross-presentation and proteasomal antigen processing for MHC I and II plus Nef/Vpu downregulation of MHC-I/CD4, unlike confusables centred on DC surface/CD1 lipid presentation or proteasome assembly.

qualifier: via TRIF and IRAK1/2 to IKK, TAK1 and IRFs
name: Endosomal Toll-like receptor signaling via TRIF and IRAK1/2
rationale: Members describe TLR3/TRIF and TLR7/8/9 IRAK-TRAF6 signaling to IKK, TAK1 and IRF3/7, including UNC93B1/TLR3/TRIF deficiencies in herpes encephalitis, distinguishing it from generic NF-kB, RIG-I/interferon and necroptosis confusables.

qualifier: E1-E2 cascade and transcription factor targets
name: SUMO E1-E2 conjugation and transcription factor SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO loading onto E1 and transfer to UBC9 plus SUMOylation of transcription factors, while confusables are SUMOylation of DNA repair, replication, RNA-binding or chromatin proteins.

qualifier: of mRNA, ribosomal subunits and inositol phosphates
name: Nuclear pore complex: RNA, ribosome and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members concern NPC assembly/disassembly and export of mature mRNAs, ribosomal subunits, tRNA, Rev cargo and inositol phosphates, distinguishing it from confusables on protein import/export regulation or nuclear envelope reformation.

core: Sulfur, selenium and methylated amine metabolism
name: Transsulfuration, selenium and choline-carnitine methyl compound metabolism
rationale: Members span sulfur amino acid catabolism, sulfide oxidation, selenium methylation, MAT1A and choline/carnitine/FMO trimethylamine metabolism, unlike glutathione, broad amino acid or phenylalanine/BH4 confusables.

name: Heme degradation and bilirubin glucuronidation and excretion
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole catabolism and UGT1A1/UGT1A4/ABCC2 bilirubin conjugation and export, whereas confusables concern SLCO hepatic uptake and drug ADME.

name: Sialic acid and N-acetylglucosamine metabolism
rationale: Members cover GNE-dependent sialic acid synthesis, CMP-Neu5Ac, Neu5Ac catabolism and GlcNAc/fructose-6-phosphate phosphorylation, unlike confusables on N-glycan processing, lysosomal ganglioside catabolism or UDP-GlcNAc synthesis.

core: Macrophage lipoprotein cholesterol uptake and storage
name: Pro-foam-cell macrophage lipoprotein cholesterol uptake and storage
rationale: Members promote cholesterol import, storage, lipoprotein transport and foam cell formation, whereas confusables carry the opposing efflux, LXR and HDL-assembly arms.

name: Histone acetylation and centromeric CENP-A nucleosome assembly
rationale: Members concern HAT-mediated lysine acetylation, nucleosome and replication-dependent chromatin assembly and CENP-A deposition, distinguishing them from BAF/CHD remodeling and chromosome condensation confusables.

qualifier: biliary/intestinal ABC transporters and HDL remodeling
name: Biliary and intestinal sterol-phospholipid transport, HDL remodeling
rationale: Members span dietary lipid absorption, ABCG5/8, ABCB4 and ABCB11 biliary lipid secretion and HDL/LDL remodeling, unlike confusables on chylomicron/VLDL assembly and lipoprotein clearance.

name: Negative regulation of TGF-beta-SMAD signaling
rationale: All members concern TGF-beta receptor/SMAD signaling and its inhibition, unlike confusables on fibrosis, miRNA processing or BMP-driven mesenchymal differentiation.

name: Striated muscle adaptation: hypertrophy, atrophy and fiber-type switching
rationale: Members concern cardiac and skeletal muscle cell size control, atrophy, fiber-type transition and responses to activity or inactivity, distinguishing them from calcineurin-NFAT hypertrophy and myogenesis/contraction confusables.

name: Gastrulation and definitive endoderm formation from pluripotent cells
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, gastrulation EMT and cell migration, germ layer and definitive endoderm/gut specification plus OCT4/SOX2/NANOG targets, unlike confusables on lateral plate mesoderm and heart development.

name: Nuclear mRNA and snRNA maturation, splicing, export and surveillance
rationale: Members cover spliceosome and snRNP biogenesis, polyadenylation and histone 3'-end processing, mRNA export and nuclear exosome decay, distinguishing them from cytoplasmic mRNA decay and rRNA/Pol I-III transcription confusables.

name: Classical and alternative complement activation and its regulation
rationale: Members cover classical and alternative pathway activation, C3/C5 convertases and positive/negative complement regulation, unlike the lectin-pathway and Fc/neutrophil effector confusables.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7, IL-15, IL-21 and NK cell development
name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signaling: IL-2, IL-7, IL-15, IL-21
rationale: Members are IL-2/STAT5, IL-7, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling with NK differentiation/proliferation, distinguishing them from IL-10/12/23, IL-9 and NKT confusables.

qualifier: NK and CD8 T cells, with KIR/MHC regulation
name: NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxicity and its regulation
rationale: Members cover NK and cytotoxic T cell killing, granzyme death, KIR/MHC class Ib recognition and tolerance-related restraint, unlike confusables centred on CD4 T cell costimulation and dendritic cells.

qualifier: R-loops, protein-DNA crosslinks and transcription termination
name: Replication stress, R-loop resolution and transcription termination
rationale: Members concern replication-transcription conflicts: R-loop processing, transcription termination, DNA-protein crosslink repair and camptothecin/hydroxyurea responses, distinguishing them from double-strand break repair and telomere confusables.

name: p53-regulated apoptosis, necroptosis and cellular senescence
rationale: Members span intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis, necroptosis, oncogene/stress-induced senescence and p53 regulation, while confusables are narrow PAK-2p34, TRIF death, PML or T cell death sets.

name: White, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members cover white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation, PPAR signaling, adipose development and cold/diet-induced thermogenesis, unlike lipid droplet, lipolysis and metabolic transcription confusables.

name: Rho-family GTPase control of actin dynamics and protrusion
rationale: Members are Rho/Rac/Cdc42 GTPase cycles and effectors plus actin polymerization, lamellipodia, filopodia and motility, distinguishing them from axon guidance, cell junction and G12/13 Rho activation confusables.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and its regulation
rationale: Members concern formyl peptide receptor signaling, neutrophil recruitment and positive/negative regulation of granulocyte chemotaxis, unlike degranulation, extravasation or chemokine-production confusables.

qualifier: downstream second messengers, PKC and NF-kappaB
name: Lymphocyte antigen receptor signaling to PKC and NF-kappaB
rationale: Members describe downstream TCR and BCR signaling via second messengers, ITK/PKC and NF-kappaB (plus CD27) driving IL-2 and proliferation, unlike confusables on proximal CD3/CD28 costimulation, co-inhibition and lymphocyte development.
